topic: Describe Your Future Home(描写你未来的家)
genre: 说明 / 描写(describe an imagined future home + how it makes life better)
source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 4 Writing:describe your future home(描写一个想象中的未来之家 + 它如何让生活更好,试用非限制性定语从句)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,学校英语角以"未来生活"为主题征文。请用英语写一篇约100词的短文,描写你想象中的未来之家,内容包括:① 这个家是什么样子(智能家居/穹顶/电力墙等);② 它有哪些功能让生活更方便(家务/温度/空气等);③ 你对住在那里的感受。注意:适当使用非限制性定语从句(…, which … / …, who …),句句围绕中心。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your school's English Corner is collecting short pieces on the theme 'Future Living'. Write about 100 words describing your imagined future home, including: 1) what the home looks like (e.g. a smart home, a glass dome, a power wall); 2) the functions that make life easier (housework, temperature, air, etc.); 3) how you would feel living there. Try to use non-defining relative clauses (…, which … / …, who …).
points: 描写外观(My future home is a smart house under a glass dome, which …)
列举便利功能(An electronic servant, who never gets tired, does all the housework.)
表达感受(Living there would feel comfortable and free.)
适当使用非限制性定语从句、句句围绕中心
model_essay: My future home is a smart house built under a clear glass dome, which lets in plenty of sunlight. Most of its power comes from solar panels, so it needs very little energy to run. At its heart is a home computer, which controls the lighting, the temperature and the air. There is also a friendly robot servant, who does all the boring housework and never gets tired. When friends come over, I push a button and the walls move to make the living room larger. Living in such a home, where everything is clean and quiet, would feel both comfortable and free.
model_translation: 我未来的家是一座建在透明玻璃穹顶下的智能屋,穹顶让充足的阳光照进来。它的大部分电力来自太阳能板,所以几乎不耗能。屋子的核心是一台家用电脑,它掌管灯光、温度和空气。还有一个友好的机器人仆人,它包办所有无聊的家务,而且从不疲倦。朋友来访时,我按一下按钮,墙壁就移动,把客厅变大。住在这样一个一切都干净安静的家里,会感到既舒适又自由。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:外观 / 便利功能 / 个人感受
围绕'未来之家'展开、句句相关、非限制性定语从句使用得当、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、定语从句逗号与关系词正确、语法基本无误

required_structure: 外观 My future home is a smart house under a glass dome, which …
功能1 At its heart is a home computer, which controls …
功能2 There is a robot servant, who does all the housework.
感受 Living in such a home, where everything is clean, would feel comfortable and free.
key_expressions: My future home is a smart house under a glass dome, which lets in plenty of sunlight.
Most of its power comes from solar panels, so it needs very little energy.
A robot servant, who never gets tired, does all the boring housework.
I push a button and the walls move to make the room larger.

high_sentences: My future home is a smart house built under a clear glass dome, which lets in plenty of sunlight.
At its heart is a home computer, which controls the lighting, the temperature and the air.
There is a friendly robot servant, who does all the boring housework and never gets tired.
Living in such a home, where everything is clean and quiet, would feel both comfortable and free.

error_pairs.wrong: My home, that has a glass dome, is very bright.
error_pairs.correct: My home, which has a glass dome, is very bright.
error_pairs.note: 非限制性定语从句(有逗号)不能用 that,指物用 which。

error_pairs.wrong: The robot servant which does the housework never gets tired.
error_pairs.correct: The robot servant, who does the housework, never gets tired.
error_pairs.note: 补充说明的人用 who,且非限制性需加逗号。

error_pairs.wrong: Solar panels gives the home most of its power.
error_pairs.correct: Solar panels give the home most of its power.
error_pairs.note: 主语为复数,动词用原形 give。
